text:
Eli: Hey folks — got a vintage arcade cabinet (MAME setup, CRT intact) that won’t fit in my new place. Free pickup from SOMA if anyone wants to give it a new home :joystick: 
Maya: OMG that is legendary. Dimensions? I live near there and could help move it if needed.
Jon: Interested if it’s not heavier than a small car. Measurements + weight?
Eli: Roughly 6ft tall, 2ft deep, maybe 220-250 lbs? I can take exact measurements tonight. Has a working coin door (disabled) and ~2000 games on SD.
Priya: I have a small UHaul coupon I can use for delivery. Willing to pitch $20 for gas if you can hold it a week.
Sam: Could also be a nice office centerpiece for the lounge if y’all want to adopt it for a few months :)
Eli: Appreciate the offers. I’d prefer to give it away to someone who will actually play it — office adoption is cool if ops says yes.
Maya: If no one claims by end of the week, I can take it to the office for a trial. I have a friend with a dolly and a pickup truck.
Jon: Also curious if the CRT has burn-in — don’t want a smoky Pac-Man screen lol.
Eli: Screen looks fine last I checked, minor burn-in in upper-right corner visible on darker backgrounds.
Priya: Will swing by tomorrow evening around 7pm to check it out if that works.
Sam: If Priya passes, I’ll take it off your hands. Otherwise office trial sounds fun.
Maya: Quick logistics note: there’s a narrow loading gate at the building. If we do pickup, 2 strong folks + dolly + straps recommended.
LogisticsBot: Reminder: if moving heavy equipment from a personal residence, get at least one person to sign off on safe-lift and check vehicle capacity.
Eli: Thanks @LogisticsBot — I’ll coordinate safe-lift. Address: SOMA loading dock near 4th & Harrison. DM me for exact unit.
Jon: I can bring straps and help at 7pm if Marina/Chris (friend) can get the dolly.
Priya: Confirming — I’ll come at 7pm. If anything changes I’ll ping here.
Maya: If this becomes office property, can someone check with Facilities about power/space? Don’t want it in the fire lane.
Sam: Facilities FYI: we can wall it in the old lounge alcove, but might need a surge suppressor.
Eli: Cool. If pickup tonight, first-come-first-serve. If you want to claim it without seeing, DM me and I’ll hold until tomorrow noon.
Maya: Dropping by later to measure and maybe snap pics.
Priya: Pics appreciated, especially of the control panel and coin door.
Eli: Uploading pics now: https://imgur.com/example (placeholder)
Jon: Nice cabinet art. If I end up with it, I’ll name it "Arcade-9000" and bring it to company party.
Maya: Please no naming it worse than "Arcade-9000" :laughing: 
Sam: Note to self: practice Smash if this goes to office.
Eli: Thanks all. Will update after tonight’s check.
Priya: If I snag it, I’ll pay for a mattress dolly rental.
Maya: Huge :thumbsup: for the hookup.
Eli: Last update: Priya is taking it! She paid for a small delivery and will pick up tomorrow noon. Thanks everyone for the offers.
Sam: Congrats Priya :tada:
Jon: Nice catch. Pi-powered high scores incoming.
Priya: Woo! Thanks y’all. I’ll post a pic of setup once it’s home.
Maya: Can’t wait to see it.
Eli: Thanks team — glad it’s going somewhere it’ll be loved. :heart:
